```objc UICollectionViewCompositionalLayout *layout = [[UICollectionViewCompositionalLayout alloc] initWithSectionProvider:^NSCollectionLayoutSection *(NSInteger section, id<NSCollectionLayoutEnvironment> layoutEnvironment) { if (layoutEnvironment.traitCollection.userInterfaceStyle == UIUserInterfaceStyleDark) { return [self sectionForUserInterfaceStyle: UIUserInterfaceStyleDark]; } else { return [self sectionForUserInterfaceStyle: UIUserInterfaceStyleLight]; } }]; ```
